what: Buyer paid for a yearly subscription to Revid on November 29, 2025 via Lemon Squeezy and the payment did not post; buyer has tried every help form on both Lemon Squeezy and Revid; has needed to email the owners of both companies to try to get the issue resolved; is trying to avoid initiating a chargeback on an American Express card.
verbatim_snippet: "I would not recommend doing business with any company that uses this service as their payment processor I've paid for years subscription to revid on November 29th 2025 and it did not post I have tried every help form both on lemon squeezy and revid and have needed to email the owners of both lemon squeezy and revid to try to get this resolved so I don't have to initiate a chargeback on my American Express card. Buyer beware!"
notes: Reviewer: Laurie Jude. Product: Revid (AI video tool), yearly subscription. Payment method: American Express. Specific purchase date stated in snippet: November 29, 2025. Full text visible in search index for this Trustpilot page. Also confirmed by subagent direct page access.
